items.name: Kris Cheppaikode
items.subtitle: Attended Whimsical Wednesday and Make Friends with the Stage
items.story: Semi-experienced New Yorker here. Improvlore is great for beginners looking to meet new people, have some fun and workout their "doing things before they know how" muscles. Also great for more experienced improvisers looking to brush up on their skills.

items.name: Kynan D'Souza
items.subtitle: Attended workshop and performed a show
items.story: It was intimidating at first facing so many talented individuals but most were quite friendly and inclusive and welcoming.

items.name: Saloni Singh
items.subtitle: Regular performer since 2025
items.story: I gained a lot of confidence in being on stage and learnt a lot about the craft of improv from Bala and Arjun which was quite fun. A life changing experience for me. Would highly recommend 10/10

items.name: Rohit Iyengar
items.subtitle: Regular performer since 2024
items.story: I knew only Arjun, because we had performed together in Dubai and now I have the best set of co-performers on stage and friends off-stage. They have brought so much joy and fun to my life in Bangalore. I'd highly recommend giving improvlore a try!
